## Final search classification

The required search returned 243 matches in 45 files.

- Current operation-certificate guidance. `README.md`, `docs/event-schema.md`, `docs/manifest-signing.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md`, and `docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl` are the approved edit set. Current gate statements now identify a DSSE envelope, an SSHSIG signature over its PAE bytes, an Ed25519 signing key, and the signing environment through the certificate principal. Legacy gate-HMAC statements say that the record remains readable but cannot certify a current gated operation. Generic HMAC API statements retain their non-gate meaning.
- Accurate maintained material. `docs/cli-reference.md` contains generated current `verify-opcert` guidance. `docs/identity-setup.md` documents the separate authorship DSSE and SSHSIG flow. `docs/README.md` indexes the migration record. `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md` cites DSSE as research grounding for literal-byte signing. These files need no F09 edit.
- Mixed maintained material needing follow-up. `docs/attest-substrate.md` correctly describes DSSE and SSHSIG but still names the removed HMAC registry module and retired policy. `docs/exit-codes.md` still labels `verify-signature` as HMAC verification. `docs/config.md` still links to an HMAC snapshot trust model. `docs/identity.md` correctly documents authorship but uses stale HMAC comparisons for `verify-signature`. These paths and related public docstrings are recorded in `deft-intangible-xanclomys`. `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` correctly states that the webhook plugin provides no HMAC request signing, but its `mcp-hmac-signing-key` deployment path needs the read-only assessment recorded in `ultrashort-burnedout-gibbon`.
- Historical decision and migration evidence. `docs/migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/adr/0005-snapshot-cache-architecture.md`, `docs/adr/0008-secrets-source-ssm.md`, `docs/adr/0009-review-bot-pipe.md`, `docs/adr/0014-inbound-webhook-auth.md`, `docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`, `docs/adr/0044-asymmetric-attestation-substrate.md`, `docs/adr/0045-authenticated-identity.md`, `docs/adr/0046-security-posture-and-accepted-limitations.md`, `docs/adr/0049-opcert-asymmetric.md`, `docs/adr/0073-reopen-invalidation-validity-on-read.md`, `docs/adr/0098-operation-scoped-config-and-provider-composition.md`, and `docs/adr/0101-non-codebase-acceptance-criterion-tag.md` record decisions at their historical points. They remain unchanged. Current guidance now cites ADR 0073 after its renumbering from the colliding ADR 0009 identifier.
- Experiment evidence. All 15 matched paths under `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/`, including the criteria generator and run corpora, preserve captured inputs and outputs and remain unchanged.

`docs/llm-framework.md` and `src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt` produced no keyword match and remain unchanged as required. The sign help accurately describes the generic command at its current level. Broader non-keyword signing language in the LLM guide is outside F09 and is recorded in `deft-intangible-xanclomys`.

## Completed checks

- The seven-file diff satisfies the four-fact current-certificate checklist and the explicit legacy non-certification checklist.
- `git diff --name-only -- docs/llm-framework.md src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt` returned no paths.
- Added prose passed a manual writing-policy review. No persistent prose or character check was added.
- `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passed.
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py -q` passed with 4 tests.
- `python -m pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py -q` passed with 23 tests.
- The full suite was not run under the approved reduced policy.
